d: A crucial diplomatic engagement is underway in New Delhi as Nepal Prime Minister Balendra "Balen" Shah meets Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Hyderabad House for high-level bilateral talks during his two-day state visit to India on November 22–23. Marking Shah’s first visit to India—and his first bilateral trip abroad—since assuming office in March 2026, the visit began with a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan, accompanied by a 34-member Nepali delegation including Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle, Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal, and Chief Adviser Kumar Byanjankar.
